mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: thm zero = h0 ; thm (suc n) = hsucc n (thm n)
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Write explicit clausal equations over constructors (`zero`, `suc n`), using `with` for intermediate scrutiny and `()` for empty patterns.
dialect_pitfalls: Dot patterns or `with`-abstractions failing when indices depend on non-variable terms
Non-structural recursion rejected without an explicit `WellFounded` accessibility witness

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: P? x : Dec (P x) | from-yes (P? x)
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Use `from-yes (m <=? n)` for closed decidable goals and `with P? x` to split on `(yes p)` vs `(no ~p)`.
dialect_pitfalls: Computing with unary `Nat` decision procedures blows up on large numerals unless `Builtin.Nat` is used
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: by decide

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: prf lhs | rewrite eq1 | rewrite eq2 = refl
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Prefer explicit `cong` / `subst` or `-Reasoning` chains over deeply nested `rewrite` clauses.
dialect_pitfalls: `rewrite` fails with ill-typed `with`-abstraction when the goal's type depends on the rewritten subterm in a non-generalizable way
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: simp only [add_comm, mul_zero]

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: record IsGroup (G : Set) : Set where ... | {{_ : IsGroup G}}
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `agda-stdlib` bundled records (`Group c l`, `Ring c l`) to Lean 4 `[Group G]` / `[Ring R]` typeclass binders.
dialect_pitfalls: Opening multiple algebraic records simultaneously in Agda causes field name shadowing unless renamed
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: class Group (G : Type u) extends Monoid G, Inv G where ...

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: {! -m !} | solve 2 (\ x y -> lhs := rhs) refl
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Replace reflective `+-*-Solver.solve` calls with `ring` / `omega` and Mimer-generated term trees with `aesop` / `grind` in Lean 4.
dialect_pitfalls: Agda has no runtime tactic engine; all search happens at edit time or via explicit reflection
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: aesop (add safe ...) or omega

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: begin a  h1  b <= h2  c
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `begin a  h1  b <= h2  c ` directly to a Lean 4 `calc` block.
dialect_pitfalls: Mixing `__` and `<=__` requires opening the preorder reasoning module rather than propositional equality reasoning
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: calc a = b := h1 _ <= c := h2 _ < d := h3

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: record Setoid c l : Set (suc (c  l)) | data _/_ (A : Type) (R : A -> A -> Type)

dialect_pitfalls: Standard Agda lacks kernel quotients; every function on a Setoid carries an explicit `cong` field
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: Quot.sound (h : a ~ b) or Quotient.lift f h_resp

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: inv (step h) = h ; inv ()

dialect_pitfalls: `--without-K` restricts pattern unification when self-equality of indices would require Streicher's K axiom
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: injection h with h1 h2 or contradiction

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: record GaloisConnection (P Q : Poset c l1 l2) : Set ...

dialect_pitfalls: Agda parameterizes posets by both underlying equality `` and order `<=` (`Poset c l1 l2`), whereas Lean 4 uses `PartialOrder ` on `=`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: GaloisConnection l u meaning l a <= b <-> a <= u b

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: [ x in A ] P x | (x , px) | proj s | proj s
